architecture_requirement: The runner records the accepted, quantized coordinate values and their applied logical ticks.
finding: The architecture specifies no decimal quantum, grid spacing, or rounding mode. The deployed server already converts accepted numeric coordinates to Python float, whose representation is IEEE-754 binary64.

decision.authoritative_rule: Reject booleans and non-numeric values; convert an accepted integer or float to the server's canonical IEEE-754 binary64 value; reject non-finite and out-of-arena results; apply that exact binary64 to GameSession.
decision.application_boundary: Quantization occurs before authoritative pending-aim storage, aim application, attack locking, collision use, and recorder observation.
decision.recorder_rule: The recorder copies the exact binary64 value already applied by GameSession. It performs no independent rounding, normalization, clamping, or coordinate conversion.

implementation.existing_behavior_formalized: GameSession previously used the same float(value), finite-value, and arena-bound checks. The named quantizer preserves those numerical semantics.
implementation.scientific_classification: Implementation plumbing only; not physiology, neuroscience, biomechanics, controller calibration, or a new game mechanic.

supersedes.reason: The attempt-2 wording said quantization was not added and therefore did not explicitly satisfy the architecture's accepted-quantized-values requirement.

scope: M09 input representation and recorder provenance only. No GameSpec, strike radius, walking, timing, neural input, encoder, decoder, controller, graph, kernel, or scientific model parameter changes.
